candidate_rejections.candidate: Ark Construction exact one-development card instruction
candidate_rejections.reason: Native instruction is ordinary placement of a single development, with capacity/modifier already asked by Q21/Q08 and reserve placement by Q18/Q01. Its title/quantity adds consultation, no new timing or eligibility branch.
Native when-claimed discard for a fixed payment uses the claim/discard/payment mechanism already asked by Q25/Q37/Q49. A different fixed payment is consultation.

candidate_rejections.candidate: Bryan Stinson claim/discard activation by itself
candidate_rejections.reason: Do not credit unasked activation cost to Q07. His distinct emergency targets, two-card theft, participating corporations and state are asked there. The on-claim discard-before-theft mechanism is already asked by Q49; combining that mechanism with the already asked emergency targets does not introduce a new issue.

candidate_rejections.candidate: Unasked End of Turn header for Alex/Marco or Coach mandatory status
candidate_rejections.reason: Do not score these as asked in Q42/Q45/Q89. End-of-turn use/order/once/optionality already explicitly asked by Q03/Q14; Coach contains no may and no End header, an application of those instructions. No new trigger procedure.

candidate_rejections.candidate: More sector coefficients, investment table rows, event fixed values or duplicate action copies
candidate_rejections.reason: Same procedure with coefficients, counts, names or duplicate components. Q68/Q73/Q76 remain fixed reference checks with zero novelty credit.

candidate_rejections.candidate: Every setup/demand vector or lower event placement list
candidate_rejections.reason: Q01/Q15/Q19 ask actual placement/comparison/track procedures. Individual vectors are source consultation.

candidate_rejections.candidate: Federalist happens to be undealt; another rival tie or threshold arithmetic
candidate_rejections.reason: Q01 asks the extra-rival allocation and Q16/Q81 ask victory tests. These are mechanical consequences/recombinations, not a distinct procedure.

candidate_rejections.candidate: Further Root/illness/reserve or android-swap number variants
candidate_rejections.reason: Q09/Q10/Q11/Q18/Q21/Q51 already ask the distinct capacity, cascading, failed-attempt and timing rules.

candidate_rejections.candidate: General impossible-cost success, universal partial resolution, Chief revival or interrupt stack
candidate_rejections.reason: Assigned sources do not supply a universal framework. SG01 remains pending; SG03 retains the explicit cancellation/status/no-refund scope only.

complete_setup.consultation_only: Printed placement vectors and matching board/card-family layout, not new procedures.
